title: KAITO — A Lively DJ Appears?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, KAITO.
Here's that blend we were talking about.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's nice...
You really do make the best coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, stop. Flattery won't get you anywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you really love coffee, don't you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just so interesting, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Interesting how?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each type of bean, how they're blended together, how fine or coarse they're ground, how they're steeped, how they're brewed... All of it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The sheer number of combinations gives you so many paths to choose from. There's no end to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. So you enjoy trying different types and blends?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And speaking of which... Toya is a bit of a connoisseur himself, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I finally got to meet him, but we didn't get a chance to talk about coffee.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They had their hands full with what was going on with Akito, so I'm not sure he would've had the time to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. But now that things have settled down, you may get your chance soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, lo and behold...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's so nice to see you!
Especially you, Toya! I've been waiting to have a chat with you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! I heard from MEIKO and the others that you're a bit of a coffee expert, and I've been wanting to pick your brain about a few things!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not really an expert...
I just enjoy good coffee is all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what I'm saying! It's natural to want to enjoy something you like to the fullest, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Come, sit with me!
I'll be borrowing a few things, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I, um... Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please excuse him, Toya. I'm sure you and your team have plans to discuss...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we were heading home after finishing practice and decided to stop by...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, if that's the case, would you mind lending Toya to us for a while? KAITO's been desperate to talk to him...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We don't mind, but it's up to you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You okay with that, dude?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't mind if it's just for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO helped us with how to get through to Akito, so I feel like we owe him at least this much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. Uh, sorry for making you do this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, if it's about coffee, I'll be happy to oblige.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO looks so excited to see you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Don't keep him waiting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'll go talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO's been waiting such a long time to find someone to talk to about coffee. I hope you'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's all good. I don't think any of us knew just how much KAITO loves coffee...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He really does. He's very particular about how he wants his made and we also told him about how Toya is a little like him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you for joining me, Toya.
The truth is, I want to create the greatest blend ever out of all the different kinds of coffee I've discovered!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you mind doing a little taste test with me? I'm curious to hear what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Are you sure about someone like me doing this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I want to hear from someone who truly loves coffee! Let's start with the first blend...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see... These are quite different. The first is fruity and the second has a floral accent, yes...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nicely done!
Each one uses a different type of bean as its base.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've been roasted in what should be the most optimal way as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe we should've done an actual cupping session instead of a taste test like this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. Have you heard of what cupping is? It's when you compare different beans or blends and give each a detailed score.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have no idea what they're talking about...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO is as knowledgeable about coffee as he is about music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He may not look it, but he's very good at researching topics. What I know about coffee pales in comparison to what he knows.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't know there was that side to him...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That part of him is a little complicated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The best way to put it may be that he gets what he has to do out of the way so that he can fully enjoy what he wants to do, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fully enjoy what he wants to do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. He generally doesn't want to spend time on anything other than the things he wants to do or enjoys doing most.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. I sort of get how he feels.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But KAITO will be KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, what does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You promised that you'd practice singing with us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Gasp*!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, I did...? I did, didn't I...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yes, you did!
We've been waiting forever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! KAITO, you big, stupid dummy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ahh, please...!
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? That's probably his biggest fail.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, one minute he sounds cool and the next he just falls flat on his face...
